messages.subject: External affairs, copper and industrial transformation | Ragunauth Ramsaroop
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Prang,

Aurubis' position across copper, recycling and industrial transformation creates a strong need for disciplined external affairs, regulatory engagement and stakeholder execution. Those priorities align closely with the work I lead today inside a major mining operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I manage senior institutional engagement, coordinate regulatory and stakeholder matters across operating and corporate teams, and translate external commitments into accountable owners, evidence, timelines and escalation. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I am exploring senior international roles where this combination of external affairs, government relations, sustainability and operator-side industrial experience could support growth and transformation. Aurubis' copper and circular-economy agenda is especially relevant to that background.

I would value a conversation about where my experience might support Aurubis' external-affairs or broader strategic stakeholder priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Aurubis.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
